inputs.name: Samples
inputs.description: One row per tissue block / adjacent-section pair. Raw platform inputs are directories: on Flow they are selected as data and materialised to a path the pipeline reads.

samplesheet.name: Samplesheet
samplesheet.description: CSV with one row per pair_id. Directory columns point at raw MERSCOPE/Xenium export folders or reusable SpatialData .zarr stores.

columns.name: merscope_dir
columns.description: Raw MERSCOPE region export directory (transcripts.parquet, cell_boundaries/, images/, ...).

columns.name: merscope_spatialdata_path
columns.description: Reusable MERSCOPE SpatialData .zarr directory (skips build when present).

inputs.name: Reference data
inputs.description: Assets MerXen hardcodes as absolute paths on the workstation. On Flow they are provided as data inputs. Required only for the stages that consume them (MECR, hierarchical clustering annotation, MapMyCells).

mecr_neurons_h5ad_path.name: WHB neurons H5AD
mecr_neurons_h5ad_path.description: Whole-brain 10Xv3 neuron raw expression matrix (MECR reference).

mecr_nonneurons_h5ad_path.name: WHB non-neurons H5AD
mecr_nonneurons_h5ad_path.description: Whole-brain 10Xv3 non-neuron raw expression matrix (MECR reference).

mecr_taxonomy_metadata_path.name: WHB taxonomy metadata
mecr_taxonomy_metadata_path.description: Cluster annotation term metadata CSV (MECR + clustering annotation).

clustering_squidpy_broad_marker_lookup_p.name: Broad marker lookup
clustering_squidpy_broad_marker_lookup_p.description: Query-marker JSON used for hierarchical clustering broad annotation.

clustering_squidpy_broad_taxonomy_metada.name: Broad taxonomy metadata
clustering_squidpy_broad_taxonomy_metada.description: Taxonomy metadata CSV for clustering broad annotation.

inputs.name: Analysis options
inputs.description: Which downstream segmentation branches and optional stages run. These control which output directories are produced.

analysis_segmentation.name: Analysis segmentation branches
analysis_segmentation.description: Downstream branch set. both=reseg,original_seg; all adds proseg_hybrid.

enable_alignment.name: Enable alignment
enable_alignment.description: Register paired sections with Spateo (paired mode only).

outputs.name: Source SpatialData
outputs.description: Per-platform source SpatialData .zarr store built from raw data or symlinked from cache.

outputs.name: Segmentation
outputs.description: Cellpose masks, ProSeg base SpatialData .zarr, and stitching diagnostics.

outputs.name: Enrichment
outputs.description: Per-shape assignment summaries and the updated latest SpatialData .zarr.

outputs.name: Viewer cache
outputs.description: Napari viewer derived caches written into the latest SpatialData .zarr.

outputs.name: Mask image quantification
outputs.description: Per-channel Cellpose cell x image-stat matrices.

outputs.name: MECR reference
outputs.description: Shared whole-brain reference markers and statistics.

outputs.name: Alignment
outputs.description: Spateo alignment transform and centroid coordinate tables.

outputs.name: Comparison
outputs.description: Paired MERSCOPE vs Xenium gene-count comparison tables.

outputs.name: Spatial gene analysis
outputs.description: Spatial autocorrelation and transcript pattern outputs.

outputs.name: Squidpy clustering
outputs.description: Clustered AnnData, UMAP/spatial plots, and hierarchical annotation.
